ACCELERATE · ICON · ROUND TWO

Nine more, around Warp and Afterburn.

Warp's one weakness was 16 px. Afterburn's was that it read as an arrow before a ship. The first group fixes Warp, the second fixes Afterburn, and the third crosses them. The two originals sit first, dashed and greyed on the desktop, so every new one can be judged against what it came from.
